trails.name: El Camino Real de Tierra Adentro National Historic Trail - Mission Trail
trails.why: The Camino Real, also known as the Silver Route, was a Spanish road used from 1598 to 1882.

trails.name: Sendero Histórico Ruta de la Plata
Iztaccíhuatl summit
trails.why: Iztaccíhuatl is a seismically active volcano located in central Mexico and is the third highest mountain in the country, after Orizaba Peak and Popocatépetl. It is located within the territorial boundaries of the states of Mexico and Puebla.

trails.name: Malinche summit
trails.why: La Malinche, also known as Matlalcueye or Malintzin, is an active volcano located in the states of Tlaxcala and Puebla in Mexico.

trails.name: El Pinal summit near Amozoc de Mota
trails.why: The Pinal is a mountain of volcanic origin in the Mexican state of Puebla, with an altitude of 3280 meters.

trails.name: La "M" summit
trails.why: The Cerro de Chipinque is a mountain in the San Pedro Garza García, Monterrey and Santa Catarina municipalities; state of Nuevo León, Mexico.

trails.name: Cerro de la Silla
trails.why: Cerro de la Silla is a mountain that is part of the eastern Sierra Madre foothills system.
